name: Squid
summary: Squid, one of the island’s most popular seafood plates, best eaten back on shore after a night squid-fishing trip.
howToEat: Join a night squid boat and eat the catch back on shore, or buy squid at the Dinh Cậu night market.
where: A night squid boat, then the shore. The Dinh Cậu night market sells it too.
seoDescription: Squid is one of Phu Quoc’s most popular seafood plates, eaten on shore after a night catch or bought at the Dinh Cậu night market.
